candidates.description: This feature vector represents chemical elements, compounds, and related nomenclature.
This feature vector represents the physiological, mechanical, or logistical process of moving, taking in, or containing substances, materials, or data.
This vector represents verbs and nouns denoting general quantitative or qualitative change and modification.
This feature vector represents microscopic physical matter and its fundamental structural components.
This feature vector represents the concepts of thermal energy, heat, and thermodynamic properties.
This vector represents adverbial modifiers of frequency, probability, and logical connection.
This vector represents measurable quantities, proportions, and concentrations of substances or elements.
This vector represents the concept of sufficiency, adequacy, and practical effectiveness or capability.
This vector is related to the concepts of manufacturing, creation, and generation of goods or outcomes.
This feature represents numbers typically associated with statistical data, codes, or sequential lists.
